notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

I just wanted to give a brief update on the things that are happening currently and what will happen in the near future.

First of all, thanks to everyone who is playing the game - I hope you enjoy it! Your support means a lot to a solo developer. Feel free to share all of your feedback, ideas, and wishes either in the Steam Community or on the official Discord. Here is the link to it: LINK TO DISCORD SERVER

Regarding the work happening behind the scenes, I am working on releasing an update that will enable Steam Workshop. This means you will be able to share your cool level creations with others. Additionally, I am planning to bring some improvements to the In-Game Level Editor, which will include more objects to populate your levels. There will also be enhancements for placing important objects in your levels and providing appropriate pop-ups to ensure you have everything you need to play the level properly. Full localization of the In-Game Level Editor is also planned. I may also include some additional pre-placed objects in the default level, allowing you to focus purely on unleashing your imagination and going wild!

As you can see, the focus for the next update will mainly be on the In-Game Level Editor. However, I also have plans for additional game modes with different playstyles in the near future. Depending on player interest, I might expand the current game modes with additional content as well.

Thank you, and keep rolling!

notes.title: Patch notes 09.05
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

Here comes another smaller update/patch, and you can find all the things that were changed below:


 Fixed an issue where it is not possible to select the bonus levels in the level selection menu when playing with joystick.
 Adjusted difficulty of Level 16 (Easy and Hard) and Level 19 (Easy and Hard) in the Time Rush mode.
 Adjusted initial camera angle.
 Fixed wrong button focus in the game mode selection menu when playing with joystick.
 Fixed wrong hovered button style in the bonus level selection menu.
 Added tags to certain actors in the Speed Run level to prevent accidental double jumping.
 Added collision to the chains of the pendulum traps in the Speed Run mode.
 Fixed an issue where air control effect would change after activating slow motion.


Feel free to let me know if you have any issues, or feedback that could improve the game and I will gladly consider it.

Thank you and keep rolling!

notes.title: Patch notes 04.05
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

Here is another patch for the game! You can find all the things that were changed/fixed below:


 Fixed issue with the mad snowman continuing to shoot at the player even after the player has fallen down in Speed Run mode. 
 Added a pop-up about the mad snowman before reaching the shooting area in Speed Run mode. 
 Centered some pop-ups. 
 Changed the order in the game mode select menu; Speed Run is now the first option, and Prelude is the last one. 
 Made slight adjustments to the control of the ball in Speed Run mode.


Feel free to let me know if you have any issues, or feedback that could improve the game and I will gladly consider it.

Thank you and keep rolling!

notes.title: Patch notes 21.04
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

At the usual tempo, as with the last two days, here is another patch for the game! You can find all the things that were changed/fixed below:


 Added a meters counter to the Speed Run game mode.
 Fixed the input image for interaction with Timur, which was being shown as text instead of an image for certain languages like Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.
 Fixed an issue where a white square image was shown instead of the correct input image when using a controller and being in a conversation with Timur.
 Fixed an issue where the mad ball would not respawn in the Speed Run game mode.
 Changed the font in the interaction message with Timur to the general game font.
 Adjusted the position of the text to better match the indicator when in conversation.


Feel free to let me know if you have any issues, or feedback that could improve the game and I will gladly consider it.

Thank you and keep rolling!

notes.title: Patch notes 20.04
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

Not even a day after the previous patch, here comes another :D No worries, nothing is broken, but I am trying to fix any issues that I discover as quickly as possible, and this patch also contains some balancing updates, mainly on the Challenge levels. You can find all the things that were changed below:


 Fixed hint pop-up not being localized in any language when running the 1st Challenge level.
 Fixed hint pop-up being shown infinitely in the 1st Challenge level; it should be shown only 2 times now.
 Fixed mad ball SFX being in the wrong class, causing it not to be audible if music is muted and not effects.
 Fixed an issue where the boy's face would turn black if playing on Medium settings.
 Layout changes in the Speed Run level.
 Balanced all Challenge levels timing to make them a little bit easier.


Feel free to let me know if you have any issues, or feedback that could improve the game and I will gladly consider it.

Thank you and keep rolling!

notes.title: Patch notes 19.04
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

Here comes another smaller update/patch, and you can find all the things that were changed below:


 All instances where the ball could get stuck in the Prelude level should be fixed now.
 Added hints to the beginning of Speed Run and Challenge levels that slow motion and jumping can be used.
 Adjusted tutorial pop-ups to cover controls with the gamepad.
 Some localization fixes and adjustments within the UI.
 Adjusted the friction of the soccer ball in the Prelude level.
 Slightly increased the mass of the ball in the Prelude level.
 Minor visual glitches fixed.

Feel free to let me know if you have any issues, or feedback that could improve the game and I will gladly consider it.

Thank you and keep rolling!

notes.title: Small update - Patch 01
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

First of all, many thanks for the support so far and to all the people who bought and tried the game. I hope all of you are enjoying it, even if just a little bit!

Here comes the first and small patch which will address some smaller issues in the game. 

 Holding the cursor and WASD keys doubles the movement speed of the ball.
 Fixed an issue where accidentally pressing the LEFT CTRL key activates the reveal mesh effect, while it is already activated in Time Rush Hard levels.
 Fixing some visual issues such as LODs, floating objects, and improperly working shadows.
 Fixed an issue where some objects were hidden when they shouldn't be and vice versa in Time Rush Hard mode.
 Fixed clipping arrows in the Challenge levels.
 Visual updates have been made to the Challenge levels.


Thank you and keep rolling!

notes.title: Latest Development Update
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

Here comes the new update! Lately, I have been working hard to finalize the Speed Run level, and so far, you can reach almost 600 meters! I dare to say that this might be really hard to complete and that it will take a couple of hours to reach the top once it is finished. All Time Rush mode levels, together with bonus levels, are completed, and the same goes for the Challenge mode.

Besides this, I have also been working on updating the game visually. Primarily, by adding quite a lot more trees and foliage, which will make the scenery really interesting, and also by adding back the cel shader look. You can check the image below.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711611/4d182f9a65206bad039f98f52db06f663ca338c3.jpg
Also, I wanted to make Time Rush levels have a little bit more flavor to them, so you will be able to meet the boy every few levels, where you will discover a bit more of the backstory. You can check the image below.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711611/cc6d261a822d62474a1284d2b1a20e2a68aa5008.png
Don't forget to wishlist the game, and see you rolling very soon!

Developer of Roll the Ball

notes.title: Development update and localization news
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

I hope you are doing well! I wanted to share a quick update on Roll the Ball. Overall, the development is progressing smoothly, and the game is entering its final stage. I can already anticipate that the game will be released either at the end of February or the beginning of March. I want to take an extra few weeks to ensure that you have the best possible experience!

Additionally, I'm pleased to announce that the game will be localized in multiple languages, including English, Bosnian, German, French, Spanish, Turkish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean! If you have any additional language preferences, feel free to let me know!

In the coming days, I will be providing more frequent updates.

Don't forget to wishlist the game, and see you rolling very soon!

Developer of Roll the Ball
